steps.say: Ines has never touched Settings: she reads the defaults (Standard, 3 days, Tomas, Wi-Fi only on, prepare-ahead on) and no changedAt.
She chooses the Full recap length, a 7 day gap, keeps Tomas, keeps Wi-Fi only and turns prepare-ahead off.
She reads her settings back: the same five values, saved at {changedAt}.
She presses the same choices again: nothing new is recorded and changedAt is still {changedAt}.
